HowItWorks.title: How it works
HowItWorks.lead: SkipperFinder connects people who need crew for a boat with professionals of the sea.
HowItWorks.client1: A skipper, hostess, cook or deckhand, for a day or a whole cruise.
HowItWorks.client2: Only those available on your dates.
HowItWorks.client3: Approved professionals, with reviews from past trips.
HowItWorks.client4: Crew for moving a boat from port to port, too.
HowItWorks.pro1: Work from private clients, boat owners and charter companies.
HowItWorks.pro2: Found for the days you are free.
HowItWorks.pro3: A profile that gains weight with every review.
